payload.updateBody:
Salam,

Maadi Law sends an automatic acknowledgement when a lead comes in, then chases it about three hours later if the thread still looks unanswered. The firm sent us a screenshot of that chase firing again and asked why. The lead had actually come through the IVR and spoken to the firm, but because there was no typed reply, the workflow counted it as silence and chased anyway. Only a typed reply stops it today, so every phone conversation still looks unanswered to the system.

We need an inbound or answered call, IVR included, to stop the follow-up the same way a reply does, we've already told the firm this is coming. We also need to fix whatever the workflow actually checks for a reply today, then prove it on a dummy contact down both paths, reply-only and call-only, and confirm the chase stops either way. And we need to know how many contacts are sitting enrolled in this chase right now and drop the ones who've already talked to the firm. Keep this separate from the signature-reminder cadence on Document Automation, different workflow, different stop condition.

Done: a dummy contact stops the chase on a call alone, not just a reply, and the currently-enrolled queue is cleared of anyone who's already spoken to the firm.
